name: uptick
description: Audit AI workflows using workspace evidence, rank improvements, and propose instruction changes.

interface.shortDescription: Improve how you work with AI
interface.longDescription:
Find practical improvements in how you or your team work with AI. Uptick inspects the workspace evidence you make available, including agent instructions, skills, workflows, documentation, and verification steps.

Get ranked opportunities with supporting evidence and confidence levels, proposed instruction changes, a seven-day action plan, and ways to measure progress.

The audit is read-only: it does not edit files or send workspace contents to Uptick. It needs access to relevant workspace material through your AI tool. Limited evidence produces a limited audit, and recommendations do not guarantee savings or business results.
defaultPrompt: Audit this workspace. Show evidence and proposed changes without editing files.
